instruction: Is this review positive or negative?

negative.definition: A review is labeled 'negative' if the overall sentiment expresses dissatisfaction with the product, highlighting flaws, unmet expectations, or poor experience, even if some neutral or slightly positive aspects are mentioned; borderline cases with mixed feedback are considered negative when the criticism outweighs praise or impacts usability.
examples: The product arrived late and was damaged, and it stopped working after two days.
I regret buying this; it’s overpriced and doesn’t perform as advertised.

positive.definition: A review is labeled 'positive' if the overall sentiment shows clear satisfaction with the product, emphasizing its benefits, quality, or value, even if minor drawbacks are noted; borderline cases with slight criticism are still positive when the reviewer recommends the product or expresses clear enjoyment.
examples: Love this gadget! It works perfectly and was easy to set up, even if the manual was a bit unclear.
Great quality and fast shipping—exceeded my expectations!
